component.name: RUWAC
component.summary: Persistent terminals, remote desktops and files

description.p: RUWAC keeps terminal sessions running in a per-user daemon, so they survive disconnects and can be reattached from the desktop or the command line, locally and over SSH.
The desktop workspace combines terminal tabs and splits with an embedded RDP client (including GNOME Remote Login), saved SSH and RDP machines, clipboard sharing and file transfer.
